title: Campus energy upgrade
description: Four proposed campus upgrades: solar generation, LED lighting, main library renovation and water-saving fixtures. Synthetic reference case for evidence-led pre-credit screening.

files.name: Solar_Quote_FINAL_v3.pdf
files.text: 20 Aug 2026 supplier quote. 500 kWp on roofs and car-park shades. Price JOD 250,000. Projected yield 1,800 kWh/kWp/year. Valid 60 days. This is a supplier claim, not measured generation.

files.text: 25 Aug 2026 supplier offer. Classroom and office panel line A; high-bay and outdoor line B. Price JOD 180,000. Supplier claims up to 70% lighting saving. This claim is not measured.

files.name: LED_panel_lineA_ENERGY_STAR.pdf

files.name: Library_upgrade_proposal.pdf
files.text: 30 Jul 2026 contractor proposal. Main library 6,000 m², window film and HVAC controls. Cost JOD 85,000. Claims 14% whole-building reduction. Measured baseline and performance proof are absent.

files.name: Water_saving_fixtures_brochure.pdf
files.text: 1 Jun 2026 brochure. Taps and dual-flush toilets, JOD 38,000. Claims up to 30% water saving. Baseline and product labels are absent.
